answer: An agent market can weight votes by tokens locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities still buys only 100 tokens of voting weight. Every vote leaves a public audit thread linking it to its locked stake. Viewed through this prism, even at the zenith of a sybil flood, extra names add no power: the attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital to gain influence.
